PluginData.Author: TinoGaming
PluginData.Tooltip: Fork of Viktor's Multigrid Projector with a fix for the Havok memory leak. Do not enable together with "Multigrid Projector".
PluginData.Description:
Fork of Viktor Ferenczi's Multigrid Projector (MIT license): loads blueprints with multiple subgrids into projectors and builds them. Same features and network protocol as the original.
Adds a fix for the game's Havok memory leak in block placement tests (SE-1381): armor slopes, corners and similar blocks no longer leak Havok shapes, so the game no longer runs out of Havok memory next to a damaged ship with a repair projection.
Server plugins for Torch and the vanilla Dedicated Server are on the releases page: https://github.com/dtmaster79/se-multigrid-projector/releases
IMPORTANT: never enable this together with "Multigrid Projector" by Viktor. Both patch the same game code, pick one of them.
